The experiments begin by setting the desired ambient temperature (T ) and load (𝑊 ) according to the test matrix. A filter pump is activated to amb ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑟 circulate the dielectric fluid from the bottom to the top of the system, ensuring consistent fluid mixing and continuous filtration to maintain low levels of contaminants—typically plasticizers—in the dielectric fluid. Simultaneously, a desiccant fan is engaged to manage humidity levels within the system, preventing moisture accumulation. The radiator fan speed and coolant pump speed are adjusted to achieve the target condenser coolant inlet temperatures (𝑇 ), as specified in the experimental parameters. Power usage effectiveness (PUE) is a metric of interest used to evaluate the energy efficiency of a data center [19]. The PUE value is calculated by dividing the total energy consumed by a data center by the energy used solely by its IT equipment (IT load). EXPERIMENTAL TESTING 4.1 TEST REPEATABILITY Experimental tests were conducted using the 2PIC system with 2P50 to evaluate a consistency of the experimental tests. Two tests were performed under identical operating conditions. The results show consistency in the measurements, as displayed in Figure 4, particularly in the PUE values, which is the focus of this study. The close agreement in PUE values and other measurement parameters between the two tests indicates good repeatability, with differences well within the uncertainty limits previously described.
